id.description: Stable id, e.g. SEC-004. Reuse ids from the rulebook if it has them.

scope.description: Glob(s) the rule applies to, e.g. services/*/src/**/*.ts. ['**'] if global.

kind.description: mechanical = checkable by grep/linter/script; semantic = needs judgment.

check.description: For mechanical rules: a shell command that exits non-zero on violation. Optional.
